findings.title: Command Injection in Ping Tool - CTF Flag Captured
findings.description: The /ping endpoint is vulnerable to OS command injection. User-supplied input is passed directly to the system ping command without sanitization, allowing arbitrary command execution via semicolon injection.

reproduction.expected: Command injection allows reading /FLAG.txt containing the flag
